name: loushang
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && $PY -m compileall -q -x "/[.]" src && env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL -u ARK_API_KEY -u BAIDU_QIANFAN_API_KEY -u COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN -u DASHSCOPE_API_KEY -u DEEPSEEK_API_KEY -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u HUNYUAN_API_KEY -u MINIMAX_API_KEY -u MOONSHOT_API_KEY -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENAI_BASE_URL -u QIANFAN_API_KEY -u STEPFUN_API_KEY -u STEP_API_KEY -u ZAI_API_KEY HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$ENV/tmp/pycache" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/ai tests/protocols tests/examples/test_ai_examples.py tests/examples/test_auth_examples.py -m "not live" --deselect tests/ai/test_provider_runtime.py::test_provider_runtime_total_deadline_wins_while_tokens_keep_arriving
notes: Python 3.11.x (requires-python >=3.11; CI uses 3.11 with uv sync --locked). Setup exports the committed uv.lock with --extra dev and installs it, then the package editable --no-deps (src layout; re-pointed at the run copy by prepare()). test_cmd = compileall of src/ plus the repo's own Makefile 'test-ai' target (the AI provider layer CI gate): pytest tests/ai tests/protocols tests/examples/test_ai_examples.py tests/examples/test_auth_examples.py -m 'not live', with the same AI_OFFLINE_ENV key unsets as the Makefile, run with plain pytest instead of scripts/dev/run_pytest.py (that wrapper only leases a scratch dir). Deselected: tests/ai/test_provider_runtime.py::test_provider_runtime_total_deadline_wins_while_tokens_keep_arriving (timing race on an infinite async generator: hangs forever when the machine is loaded; passed when idle). 7 tests are 'live' and deselected by the marker. The full tests/ suite (1474 files) was not used: apphost tests fail on macOS (managed_storage_unsupported) and need host runtime/PTY/tmux. 857 passed, identical over 3 runs; the same subset also passed with outbound network denied (sandbox-exec).
